description: Global studio defaults. aPoseFootwear: 'barefoot' = bare feet in every female A-pose and underlayer test (the default since Oct 2026); 'signature' = each sister's own heels (art.defaultFootwear). Change it and regenerate to flip every A-pose at once. A card's own components.footwear always wins (the x-pose-heels cards keep the heeled A-pose available). bodyContour: 'off', a piece name, or {stage: piece, default: piece} (on by default: fitted-contour, armor-contour for the armor stage); a piece name in wardrobe/effects/contour (fitted-contour, sheer-contour, armor-contour) added to every outfit, armor and scene prompt that has a ?{{BODY_CONTOUR}} line; a card's components.body_contour wins, and 'off' on a card opts out. realmByGroup: {group: realm piece} picks the default realm (how realistic the world around the hero looks) for every scene of a group; a hero's art.defaultRealm wins over it and a card's components.realm wins over both. Today only angel-primes (the test bed) uses the cinematic realm; everything else keeps realms/fantasy (illustrated high fantasy).
